==Kraken's Beak Isles==

Region: the Singing Wastes

Connects to: 02.11.03, 19.31, 19.31.04, 26.33, 29.14.38, 29.14.41 and 46.01.

==Overview==
Eccentric tinkers and traders take the occasional detour to these islets to barter with the native [[octoids]], who live in a cave system beneath the surf.
